content.text:
**Finding: missing (high severity) — no Customer termination-for-convenience right.**

- Section 9 contains only cause-based exits (9.1 material breach, 9.2 insolvency, 9.3 security/SLA/law/IP) plus 9.5 scoping; other exits are event-driven (6.2, 19.4, 27.3). There is no 9.4 and no convenience right for either party.
- The term is three years (8.1), and Section 2.1 affirmatively strips reduction/termination rights on a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay commitment — walk-away territory under the rule.
- Redline validated (ok:true): inserted a new Section 9.4 giving us the preferred 30-day convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and confirming Vendor has no mid-term convenience right, and conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay language does not defeat it. Fallback (60–90 days' notice) flagged as available in the comment.
